faces.name: Narset, Enlightened Exile
faces.oracleText:
Creatures you control have prowess.
Whenever Narset attacks, exile target noncreature, nonland card with mana value less than Narset's power from a graveyard and copy it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.

faces.name: Narset, Enlightened Master
faces.oracleText:
First strike, hexproof
Whenever Narset attacks, exile the top four cards of your library. Until end of turn, you may cast noncreature spells from among those cards without paying their mana costs.

faces.name: Narset, Jeskai Waymaster
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw cards equal to the number of spells you've cast this turn.

faces.name: Narset of the Ancient Way
faces.oracleText:
+1: You gain 2 life. Add {U}, {R}, or {W}. Spend this mana only to cast a noncreature spell.
−2: Draw a card, then you may discard a card. When you discard a nonland card this way, Narset deals damage equal to that card's mana value to target creature or planeswalker.
−6: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this emblem deals 2 damage to any target."

faces.name: Narset, Parter of Veils
faces.oracleText:
Each opponent can't draw more than one card each turn.
−2: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a noncreature, nonland card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

faces.name: Narset's Rebuke
faces.oracleText: Narset's Rebuke deals 5 damage to target creature. Add {U}{R}{W}. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

faces.name: Narset's Reversal
faces.oracleText: Copy target instant or sorcery spell, then return it to its owner's hand. You may choose new targets for the copy.

faces.name: Narset Transcendent
faces.oracleText:
+1: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a noncreature, nonland card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand.
−2: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand this turn, it gains rebound. (Exile the spell as it resolves. At the beginning of your next upkeep, you may cast that card from exile without paying its mana cost.)
−9: You get an emblem with "Your opponents can't cast noncreature spells."
